name: mahindra-ai-chat-agent
description: Multistage AI Chat Agent for a Mahindra-style automotive OEM, integrated with Zoho CRM

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
